topic.source_contract: Common land, town and village green registers and consent evidence

facts.register: local common land and village green register
facts.guard: register status is not freehold title
guidance or case notice is not consent

facts.process: Commons Act 2006 section 16 release and replacement land
facts.guard: application is not deregistration or exchange approval

scope_guards: Common land and town or village green registers are distinct from HMLR title.
Registration can record land status and rights of common without proving ownership.
A section 15 town or village green application is not registration until determined.
A section 16 release or exchange application is not approved deregistration.
Section 38 works consent is separate from planning permission and landowner consent.
Register rectification and amendment applications require exact authority and status review.
Public access, common rights and private title must not be treated as interchangeable.
No score or promotion is written without exact register unit, rights, application/consent status, title and planning evidence.
